bends.note: runs straight across the sheet from W. 5th, then angles down to the ESE toward W. 3rd and W. Front
W. 5th turns from straight down the sheet to SSW just above Freeman Av. and runs off the lower-left edge

ends.note: dead end at the edge of the rail yard
dead end at the Theobald Felss flour mill buildings
short 50 ft leg west of Baymiller stops at the rail yard; only the 20-inch water pipe continues across the yard to W. Front

notes: Sheet is turned about 90 degrees: north is to the LEFT, east is up. W. 5th runs down the left side; Hannibal St., Pierson St. and Freeman Av. enter from sheet 19 on the left and stop at W. 5th (railroad on the other side). Sweeney is printed 'SWEENEY (AVERY)' with no suffix (20 ft); 'Street' added. W. 3rd is not labelled on this sheet: the street entering from the top edge (from the east) to Baymiller is identified as W. Third from the key map and sheet 8, and the 50 ft leg across Baymiller on its line is the same street. Sheet 8 (north up) shows the same junction: Baymiller 66 ft north of W. 3rd and 45 ft south of it, W. 3rd 50 ft; on this sheet the '66'' label is Baymiller north of the junction, the '45'' label is Baymiller south of it, and '50'' is W. 3rd. W. 4th St. and Webb Alley enter from the top edge and stop at Baymiller. Baymiller crosses W. Front and continues ESE off the right edge (about 45-50 ft wide there, partly illegible label '4?'). W. Front (66 ft) runs straight at 45 degrees (centreline about x+y=4250) from its T on W. 5th to Baymiller. W. 5th label reads 60' near Baymiller and 66' near Pierson; measured width is about 66 ft at both. Several unlabelled lines run SE from W. Front toward the river near the Flagman shanty (x~1690, y~2740); they look like railroad property lines and are not recorded. Baymiller/W. 5th: Baymiller's far (top) side is off the sheet, so its centre is taken from the water pipe and the 66 ft width.
